#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Writes one `region,total` line for each region to `out/totals.csv`, sorted by region.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
csvtool namedcol region,amount data/sales.csv |
  tail -n +2 |
  awk -F, '{ t[$1] += $2 } END { for (r in t) print r "," t[r] }' |
  sort > out/totals.csv
